Vitamin E

Contents Uses Sources References

Vitamin E is a group of eight fat-soluble compounds that include four tocopherols and four tocotrienols.

Deficiency

Vitamin E deficiency is rare and is usually caused by an underlying problem with digesting dietary fat.
